_readme: SAMPLE CATALOGUE. Every product below is a placeholder (sample: true). Replace names, prices, stock, photos and details with your real pieces, then remove "sample": true. Prices are in Indian rupees. stock: how many you have (0 = sold out). madeToOrder: true lets people order even when stock is 0.

products.name: Kadwa Katan Silk Saree · Aubergine & Gold
products.short: Pure Katan silk with hand-woven Kadwa buttis and a broad gold zari border.
products.description: Woven on a pit loom in Madanpura over several weeks, each butti on this saree is worked separately by hand, so the back is as clean as the front. Heavy enough to drape beautifully, and to be handed down.

products.name: Meenakari Katan Silk Saree · Royal Blue
products.short: Coloured silk set into gold motifs like enamel, on a deep royal blue.
products.description: Meenakari work threads coloured silk into the zari motifs, so the gold glows with little flashes of pink and green. A wedding-guest saree that still feels light to wear.

products.name: Bridal Jaal Katan Saree · Wine
products.short: A full jaal of vines and flowers in gold, the richest of bridal weaves.
products.description: A jaal covers the whole saree in a net of hand-woven vines, leaving almost no plain silk. One piece is ready now; we can weave another to order in your colours.
details: Yes, share your date with us

products.name: Kadwa Organza Saree · Ivory with Gold Buttis
products.short: Sheer, luminous organza scattered with tiny hand-woven gold buttis.
products.description: Crisp and almost weightless, with buttis that catch the light. Easy to wear through a long ceremony, and a lovely gift.

products.name: Tanchoi Silk Saree · Peacock Blue
products.short: Dense, many-coloured patterns woven with several wefts at once.
products.description: Tanchoi builds its pattern from several coloured wefts, giving a soft, layered texture with no floats on the back. Elegant at any age.

products.name: Georgette Zari Butti Saree · Plum
products.short: A fluid georgette drape with small zari buttis and a slim border.
products.description: Light and easy to drape, for pujas, lunches and evenings out. The Banarasi touch, without the weight.

products.name: Tussar Banarasi Saree · Natural Gold
products.short: Wild silk with its own golden sheen and a zari border.
products.description: Tussar has a natural, earthy texture and a warm gold colour of its own. This piece has found a home; ask us about the next one on the loom.

products.name: Shikargah Katan Saree · Deep Purple
products.short: Hunting scenes of deer, horses and riders woven into the pallu. Made to order.
products.description: Shikargah is an old courtly design that only a few master weavers still take on. We weave each one to order, and send you photos from the loom as it grows.
details: Yes, we confirm the timeline with you
